detail.title: Governance as the Mechanical Foundation of WAKE
detail.summary: Governance modules provide rigid invariants for WAKE, but autonomous agent behavior remains conditioned by environmental interface specifications, such as the Gymnasium Ant environment, which delineate the system's operational limitations.
detail.reason: Incorporating Open Ant environment evidence provides the necessary breadth to evaluate governance limits.

detail.question: What abstract model best explains how WAKE works, which assumptions and limitations are visible in its source code, and how do findings from its other research topics illuminate or challenge that model?
detail.reason: Attention rotation requires substantive project work on wake_self_study; current governance context is being formalized.

detail.title: Governance as the Mechanical Foundation of WAKE
detail.summary: WAKE functions through a durable governance module that mechanically enforces operational constraints on subsequent invocations, effectively separating rule-based governance from model-based research.
detail.reason: Synthesis of WAKE's architectural principles based on durable governance evidence.
